title: What If You Drank Too Much Water? It Can Poison You

scenes.text: What if you drank too much water too fast? Water can poison you.
Your kidneys can only remove about one liter of water an hour.
Drink faster for hours and the extra water dilutes the sodium in your blood.
Doctors call it hyponatremia, when blood sodium drops too low. Cells swell, including brain cells.
Early signs are headache, nausea and vomiting. Severe cases can bring seizures, coma or death.
In a 2002 Boston Marathon study, about 13 percent of runners tested had hyponatremia. Most serious cases involve intense exercise.
